notes: Identity independently checked: supplied text begins with the title Violence and Election Fraud: Evidence from Afghanistan, authors NILS B. WEIDMANN AND MICHAEL CALLEN, British Journal of Political Science 2012, 43(01), pp. 53-75, and DOI 10.1017/S0007123412000191. This matches the neutral original reference; it is article text spanning pp. 53-75 with methods, results, and Tables 1-3, rather than an abstract or secondary report. No PDF was named or available within the authorized inputs; layout/sign ambiguities in the canonical text cannot be resolved by rendering. Both inputs have null description and study identifiers and blank original locators. Requested metric labels alone do not identify an outcome, predictor, model, or test. No assignment was made by input order or numerical matching. Candidates: Table 2 p.72 Models 1-2 last-digit logit, Models 3-4 recount OLS; Table 3 p.73 Model 5 fraud for Karzai and Model 6 fraud for Abdullah. Table 2 reports district N=375 for each of Models 1-4; Table 3 reports district N=375 for Model 5 and N=363 for Model 6. These are candidate model Ns only, not assigned analytic Ns. No sample sum, df derivation, or metric conversion performed. Table 1 descriptive-variable Ns, the recount sample of 342 ballot boxes, and household/polling-station contributor counts are distinct roles and were not substituted for regression N. Exact target-specific exclusion accounting is unresolved. Printed candidate evidence (not assigned fields): Table 2 Model 1 election-violence entry 8.477* (SE 4.754); Model 2 pre-election-violence entry 1.872 *** (SE 0.177); Model 3 election-violence entry 0.808 * (SE 0.365); Model 4 pre-election-violence entry 0.261*** (SE 0.071). Table 3 adjacent-district violence entries 7.279 (SE 4.576) and 5.239** (SE 2.216), for Models 5 and 6 respectively. The canonical table significance legend is *p , 0.1, **p , 0.05, ***p , 0.01; corresponding candidate bounds are p<0.1, p<0.05, p<0.01, not exact p-values. Unstarred entries do not establish an exact p or a reliable numeric lower bound. Some coefficient minus signs appear lost in this text: prose describes negative quadratic terms and a negative local-violence relationship for Abdullah; signs were not repaired or converted to odds ratios. No printed candidate is promoted to an assigned value without target correspondence. Online-appendix tests are mentioned but the appendix is not included. The assigned ser_method label does not specify a printed metric or target test. Replication and reported_success are unassigned placeholders only; no replication primary source was inspected.
